heading: Thursday, April 2, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Google Gemma 4 and Alibaba Qwen3.6-Plus.

items.headline: Google releases Gemma 4 open models under Apache 2.0
items.summary: Gemma 4 is an open-weight family built from Gemini 3 research, released under the Apache 2.0 license. The lineup includes E2B and E4B edge models, a 26B mixture-of-experts model and a 31B dense model, with context windows of up to 256K tokens. Google reports the 31B model ranked #3 among open models on the Arena AI text leaderboard.

items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen3.6-Plus
items.summary: Qwen3.6-Plus is a hosted model focused on agentic coding and multimodal tasks, available on Alibaba Cloud's Bailian/Model Studio platform. Alibaba claims it is comparable to Claude Opus 4.5 on SWE-bench and Terminal-Bench 2.0.
